name: medcare
description: MedCare Twin — physiology-based digital twin for medicine simulation, training and drug development

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/engine && node --run dev:all
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/engine && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
